map.what: first-half total = a + b x T, T = the closing full-game consensus total (median of the bettable books' last pre-tip total)

table.what: rows [closing consensus total, first-half total, games]; the table's key is a + b x the total

tilt.what: dt = (h1 total - period-2 total) - (alpha + beta x Tc), both teams; tau = (this season's ended dt + w_prev x last season's) / (games + w_prev x last season's games + k)

command: python -m scripts.ncaab_first_half_total_build --cache <copy of the three reads> --quotes <tip60 first-half totals> --asof-fg <later fg_odds parts> --last-season 2026

replay.rule: every game, no games-played wait; best book; edge > cut
